components.name: Warning callout

components.name: Code block

components.name: Section heading marker

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Manuscript Grid"**

Wongoji is Korean manuscript paper: a sheet of square cells with fine printed rules, written on by hand and corrected in red. The system treats every component as something printed on that sheet or marked on it afterwards. Tabs, tags, checkboxes, and callouts read as cells and frames stamped onto the page, never as raised buttons or floating cards. The mood is quiet and exact, with the warmth of a page someone wrote on.

It serves one person's research notes, where long Korean prose, Latin species and gene names, DNA and protein sequences, math, code, and tables share a page and must each read correctly beside the others. Structure carries the identity: a filled blue square opening each section heading, ruled property rows, square tags, and one corner of each frame cut at 45°. Ornament does not.
keyCharacteristics: Square cells and fine rules instead of fills and rounded containers.
Two accents with fixed jobs: a printed-rule blue for structure, a proofreader's red for marks.
Depth from tonal steps of paper, not from shadows.
Obsidian's own component geometry, restyled in colour, type, and rules only.

rules.name: The Proof-Mark Rule
rules.body: Proofreader's Red marks; it never decorates. If a reader would not expect a proofreader to have put it there, it is not red. Body text and code tokens never use it.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Manuscript Rule Blue is the only accent. A new role gets a tone of paper, ink, or blue, not a new hue.

rules.name: The True Italic Rule
rules.body: A Latin binomial or gene name is set in real italics from Source Serif 4. Never let it fall through to a synthesized slant.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: If two regions sit at different depths, they differ in tone by at least 0.025 in OKLCH lightness, enough to read without a line. No line marks a change of layer; a line between two regions of the same tone is a rule on the page.

rules.name: The One Cut Rule
rules.body: One cut corner per frame, top right, and the line never breaks at the diagonal.

rules.name: The Stock Geometry Rule
rules.body: A component keeps Obsidian's own size and position unless this document names the difference. Restyling never moves a box.

dos: Do keep Obsidian's component sizes and positions, and prove it against stock Obsidian.
Do set Latin names in true italics.
Do keep one 45° cut per frame with an unbroken rule.
donts: Don't use Proofreader's Red for decoration, body text, or code tokens.
Don't add a second accent hue.
Don't fill the active row or tab with colour; mark it.
Don't number headings with a CSS counter; Obsidian unloads off-screen sections and the count goes wrong.
